cohort: 19 women who underwent laparoscopic detorsion for adnexal torsion and 10 women who underwent laparoscopic detorsion and cystectomy for adnexal torsion with a presumed benign ovarian cyst.
finding: Performing cystectomy during detorsion surgery for a presumed benign ovarian cyst in a torsioned ovary did not significantly affect ovarian volume or AFC.
